basis: P1 fixed 32-call comparison; current16 are development diagnostics and excluded from new training.

pick_lines.gap: Distinguish instructions, physical grabs, assortment density and realized pick density; keep numerical conclusions in the complete answer set.
designs: Reconcile a multi-location pick list with repeated physical grabs.
Compare SKU density and demand-driven activity with different area denominators.
Diagnose which conclusions remain identified when order-level records are missing.
Select a feasible reorganization under explicit assortment and visit constraints.

batch_tradeoff.gap: Combine walking avoided, separation cost, space cost and feasible interventions; require strict versus non-strict boundary handling.
designs: Reconcile a cost report with a duplicated or missing incremental component.
Choose an action under both a capacity limit and complete incremental cost accounting.
Audit scenario-dependent break-even claims without treating medium order size as a universal rule.
Compare mutually exclusive intervention bundles with explicit implementation costs.

serial_parallel.gap: Separate elapsed time from total active person-work and evaluate all deadline claims consistently.
designs: Compare sequential and overlapping work with explicit release times.
Choose staffing under both a loading deadline and person-work budget.
Identify the bottleneck after one task duration changes and consolidation remains required.
Audit a report that incorrectly adds overlapping durations or omits consolidation.

transport_capacity.gap: Find all countermodels consistent with aggregate records and per-period constraints; reject countermodels that violate observed totals.
designs: Reconcile realized movements, rejected requests and remaining capacity over multiple periods.
Choose feasible reallocation when only some requests may shift departure.
Judge existence versus necessity of unmet demand under partial records.
Compare capacity changes under peak and off-peak service constraints.

development_design_requirements: Two held-out task constructions per capability, frozen before any training.
Change inference structure and interacting conditions, not just names, numbers or option order.
Check semantic overlap with current16 and proposed training tasks; document shared source rules.
authoring_method: One source-authored candidate at a time, with separate option-level truth and exact numerical reasoning.
Answer indices derived from verified option truths; mismatched generated indices remain recorded as failures.
Cover answer-set sizes1/2/3/4 without forcing an unsupported option or question.
No formal question, option, gold answer or prediction enters source authoring.
release_gates: Operator source verification of each answer and scope, separate from model scoring; retain model-review disagreements. This does not claim an external independent reviewer.
New training tasks must not copy or simply re-number the current16 diagnostic cases.
Exclude all historical diagnostic/formal questions downstream and audit cross-split semantic overlap.
Expand source-separated retention beyond the four current checks; warehouse, enterprise process and practical Agent coverage remain unresolved.
Freeze actual data count and supervised token budget under the existing expansion plan before launching any training.
limitations: Prioritized development work based on a small selected pilot; no proof of coverage of the formal target gap. Four capability sources are one historical connected group. This file contains task specifications, not accepted tasks or a training release.
